faqs.question: What does Urine by Liquid-based Cytology measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the presence of abnormal cells, bacteria, or other substances in the urine.

faqs.question: Why is Urine by Liquid-based Cytology done?
faqs.answer: Urine by Liquid-based Cytology helps identify conditions such as urinary tract infections, bladder cancer, kidney diseases, and abnormalities in the urinary system. Hence, it is is done for various reasons, including: • To detect and diagnose urinary tract infections • To screen for bladder cancer or evaluate its recurrence • To assess kidney diseases or disorders • To evaluate abnormalities in the urinary system detected through imaging tests • To monitor the effectiveness of treatment for urinary system conditions.

faqs.question: When is Urine by Liquid-based Cytology recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may recommend this test if you experience symptoms such as frequent urination, painful urination, blood in urine, lower abdominal pain, or recurrent urinary tract infections. It is also recommended for individuals at high risk of developing bladder cancer or those undergoing treatment for urinary system disorders.

faqs.question: What if the results of Urine by Liquid-based Cytology are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate a urinary tract infection, presence of abnormal cells suggesting bladder cancer or other urinary system disorders. However, abnormal results do not confirm a diagnosis. Further diagnostic tests and consultation with your doctor are required to determine the exact condition and develop an appropriate treatment plan.

faqs.question: What to expect during Urine by Liquid-based Cytology?
faqs.answer: During this test: • You will be provided with a leak-proof container to collect a urine sample. • Ensure you collect at least 1 ml of urine and provide relevant clinical and radiological details. • The urine sample is sent to the laboratory.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before Urine by Liquid-based Cytology?
faqs.answer: To prepare for this test: • Collect at least 1 ml of urine in a leak-proof plain container. • Make sure to provide relevant clinical and radiological details. • No specific dietary restrictions or fasting are required before the test. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Urine by Liquid-based Cytology?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside Urine by Liquid-based Cytology include: • Urine culture and sensitivity testing to identify specific bacteria causing urinary tract infections and determine the most effective antibiotic for treatment. • Imaging tests such as ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI to visualize and evaluate the urinary system.

faqs.question: What is Urine by Liquid-based Cytology also known as?
What is bladder cancer?
faqs.answer: Bladder cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the cells of the bladder lining. It commonly presents with symptoms such as blood in urine, frequent urination, and lower abdominal pain. Early detection through tests like urine cytology allows for timely treatment and better outcomes.
